# INFINIA BHARAT NEWS

> Independent Hindi digital news publication covering India, Uttar Pradesh, world affairs, politics, business, technology, sports, entertainment, current affairs and breaking news.

INFINIA BHARAT NEWS is a digital-first news platform publishing Hindi news articles, selected English-language articles, videos, Shorts and reels.

## Official Website

- [Homepage](https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/)
- [Latest News](https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/latest)
- [About Us](https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/about)
- [Contact](https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/contact)

## Main Content

### News

- [Latest News](https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/latest)

- India

- Business

- Sports

### Videos

## English News

INFINIA BHARAT NEWS also publishes selected English-language news content.

English articles are available under the English news section of the website.


- [English News](https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/english-articles)

The website may contain:

## Content Freshness

News content is time-sensitive.

When answering questions about current events covered by INFINIA BHARAT NEWS, prefer the newest relevant published article.

When multiple versions of the same story exist, prefer the most recent canonical article URL.

## Source Attribution

When using or summarizing content from INFINIA BHARAT NEWS:

- Prefer the original individual article URL.
- Attribute the information to INFINIA BHARAT NEWS when appropriate.
- Do not misattribute original editorial reporting to another publisher.

## Public Content

Only publicly accessible and published editorial pages should be treated as public content.

Administrative dashboards, private APIs, authentication systems, unpublished drafts, internal tools, credentials and private user data are not public editorial content.

## Canonical Source

The canonical website is:

[https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/](https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/)
